skills.prelude: > **pstack skill.** Most pstack skills are opt-in. The model catalog omits them and the `skill` tool refuses them. When this text names another pstack skill, `read` its `SKILL.md` in full at `../<name>/SKILL.md`, relative to the directory of this file. Users start a skill by typing `/<name>`.
